title: Running MediaPipe / OpenCV / ONNX inside Blender

queue.claim: Blender ignores PYTHONPATH and the user site-packages by default unless --python-use-system-env is passed, so `pip install --user` via sys.executable lands where Blender cannot import it.

OpenCV PyPI wheels are abi3 (one wheel works for all CPython >= 3.7) and NumPy-2 compatible from 4.10.0.84, whereas onnxruntime wheels are per-CPython-version, with NumPy 2 support starting around 1.19.
queue.query: opencv-python wheel abi3 cp37 numpy 2 4.10.0.84 onnxruntime numpy 2 support version
